---
title: "Model Results"
subtitle: "Bayesian marked LGCP · NIMBLE"
---

```{r setup}
source("03_dashboard.R")
posterior_available <- file.exists("output/lgcp_posterior.rds")
if (posterior_available) {
  post <- load_lgcp_posterior("output/lgcp_posterior.rds")
}
intensity_png <- "plots/posterior_mean.png"
```

## Posterior Intensity Surface

```{r intensity-map}
if (file.exists(intensity_png)) {
  knitr::include_graphics(intensity_png)
} else {
  cat("> Intensity surface not yet generated. Run `source('master.R')` to produce it.")
}
```

The figure shows posterior mean assault intensity (events/km²) for domestic (left) and non-domestic (right) assaults across 2020–2022. Brighter areas indicate higher model-estimated risk after accounting for population density and the spatial Gaussian process.

## Parameter Estimates

```{r param-table}
if (posterior_available) {
  format_posterior_table(post$samples_comb, post$p_int, post$p_mark)
} else {
  bslib::card(
    bslib::card_header("Model artifact unavailable"),
    bslib::card_body(
      "Run `source('master.R')` (requires ≈ 2 hours on 3-core parallel) to generate
       `output/lgcp_posterior.rds`. The MCMC is run separately and not part of the
       nightly data refresh."
    )
  )
}
```

## Model Configuration

```{r model-summary}
if (posterior_available) {
  post$model_summary |>
    dplyr::select(metric, value) |>
    gt::gt() |>
    gt::fmt_integer(columns = value,
                    rows = post$model_summary$type == "int") |>
    gt::fmt_number(columns = value, decimals = 2,
                   rows = post$model_summary$type == "num") |>
    gt::cols_label(metric = "Configuration", value = "Value")
}
```
